scope: Read-only post-render audit lane for EvidenceProse companion cards
purpose: Require topology, queue authorization, primary-source surface, protected-term, and statistical/test-identity closure before a rendered card can pass.

hard_rules: Source support does not authorize renderer-added content.
Content authorized on a sibling card is not authorized on the current card unless the current queue item also authorizes it.
Protected scientific terms and instrument abbreviations must be checked as constructs, not merely by broad semantic similarity.
Every material visual relation must preserve the identity of the tested relation, including operator and outcome.
A moderation or interaction test cannot be represented as a direct association between its component variables.
Renderer-authored framing is material when it changes the apparent research question, evidence role, clinical claim, or practical conclusion.

mandatory_audit_sop.name: bind_exact_render_and_generating_item
must: bind exact generating queue digest and item digest

mandatory_audit_sop.name: bind_primary_source
must: bind primary source by DOI/title/verified filename
inspect source figure/table directly when structurally relevant

mandatory_audit_sop.name: blind_atomic_readback
must: inventory every material visible text span
record apparent research question and clinical/practical framing

mandatory_audit_sop.name: topology_and_test_identity_reconciliation
must: record operands/operator/outcome/conditioning for every material relation
fail interaction represented as direct association

mandatory_audit_sop.name: queue_surface_diff
must: compare every observed material node against current card authorization
source support must not cure missing queue authorization

mandatory_audit_sop.name: protected_term_and_primary_source_closure
must: require source locator for supported material nodes
fail invented or corrupted protected terms

mandatory_audit_sop.name: derive_verdict
mandatory_audit_sop.rule: PASS is illegal unless every mandatory closure is complete and all substantive axes pass.

mandatory_audit_sop.name: repair_projection
must: all failed repairs appear in one imgedit writing block

material_failure_rules.SOURCE_SUPPORTED_BUT_NOT_QUEUE_AUTHORIZE: FAIL_RENDER unless current card explicitly permits renderer-authored material

protected_term_gate.rule: A corruption, substitution or invented abbreviation that changes a protected scientific term is material even when the intended sentence remains guessable.

regression_cases.C03_PROTECTED_TERM_CORRUPTION: Corrupting 表現失敗相關性抑制 must FAIL_RENDER.
regression_cases.C05_WRONG_TEST_IDENTITY: Rendering null attachment × SES/SIS1 moderation as null direct attachment -> SES/SIS1 relations must FAIL_RENDER.
regression_cases.C06_SIBLING_LEAKAGE: A source-supported FSFI/IIEF note not authorized on C06 must FAIL_RENDER.
regression_cases.C07_INVENTED_ABBREVIATION: AAS must FAIL_RENDER when ECR is the authorized/source instrument and AAS is unsupported.
regression_cases.C08_ADDED_CORE_QUESTION: Renderer-added diagnostic/treatment-effectiveness core-question framing must FAIL_RENDER when the study did not test those endpoints.
